patch_list: Allow custom Android Auto hosts

Lets TIDAL's car media browser accept a third-party Android Auto host such as DriveDeck or Gearslip. Only the host admission check changes; TIDAL's accounts, subscription, catalogue and playback services stay active.

sources.label: Material 3 Expressive redesign, Material You theming, swipe gestures, and option
sources.author: MaterialTidal
patch_list: In-app patch settings

Adds a 'MaterialTidal' menu inside TIDAL's main Settings screen so you can toggle and customize installed MaterialTidal patches live without re-patching, with quick controls, organized sub-pages, and per-page or full reset.
Linn Majik DSM Wi-Fi playback
Discovers Linn DS/DSM OpenHome speakers on your local Wi-Fi in TIDAL's Devices sheet and streams Lossless or Hi-Res FLAC audio with full transport, queue, hardware volume, and lockscreen controls.
M3 albums, artists & library
Extends M3 design (fading hero artwork, adaptive Monet colors, pill controls, and a Bento-style Collection tile grid) to Albums, Artists, My Tracks, and your Library.
M3 bottom sheets & menus
Redesigns Song & Playlist action menus as clean tap-anchored M3 popups with crisp vector icons, alongside rounded bottom sheets, grouped menu cards, overflow menus, and M3 dialogs.
M3 full player

Redesigns the Now Playing screen with a blurred cover-art backdrop, adaptive Monet colors, animated squiggly seekbar, expressive transport controls, responsive tablet two-pane layout, full-screen lyrics, and a refreshed Play Queue.
M3 homepage
Redesigns the Homepage with rounded M3 shortcut and carousel cards, Monet-styled Vibe chips and top bar, pull-to-refresh support, and optional removal of promotional banners.
M3 navbar & mini-player

Replaces TIDAL's bottom bar and mini-player with a floating M3 split-pill navigation dock, detached Search button, and separate floating mini-player card with swipe gestures and progressive backdrop blur.
M3 playlist screen

Redesigns Playlist pages with a full-bleed fading hero cover, cover-adaptive or Monet colors, pill Play/Shuffle controls, compact expressive action buttons (or full hide), scroll-morphing toolbar, and polished track rows.
M3 search
Redesigns Search & Explore with rounded Monet search bars, frosted sticky headers, expressive filter pills, and Monet-harmonized genre and browse cards.
Material You dynamic theme

Applies your Android wallpaper's Material You Monet colors, rounder M3 shapes, and smooth frosted-glass blur across TIDAL's surfaces, accents, and cards. Options can also be adjusted live in Settings → MaterialTidal.
Seamless track transitions (Crossfade)

Unlocks dual-player Crossfade with adjustable duration (0–12 s), 4 audio fade curves, blend intensity, gapless-album preservation, and a clean full-screen Crossfade menu in Settings and the Now Playing menu.
Song waveform seekbar
Replaces the player seekbar with an animated audio waveform generated from the playing track, featuring smooth track transitions, scrub zoom, and optional real-time beat pulse.
Syllable-synced karaoke lyrics

Upgrades full-screen lyrics with word-by-word karaoke sweep highlighting, gentle lift physics, depth-of-field blur on inactive lines, duet layout, and open community lyric providers with automatic fallback to TIDAL lyrics.
System Light & Dark theme

Adds a Material You Light Mode and automatically switches TIDAL between Light and Dark themes following your Android system setting (or locks to Light or Dark), adapting surfaces, icons, text contrast, dialogs, and system bars.
Track swipe gestures
Adds spring-back left and right swipe actions to track rows across playlists, albums, search, and your library (Add to Queue, Play Next, Favorite, or Add to Playlist).

sources.label: Morphe patches for TIDAL - Spotify style swipe right to add to queue
sources.author: chukfinley TIDAL
patch_list: Swipe to add to queue
Adds a Spotify style swipe right gesture that adds the swiped item to the play queue, on every screen that lists tracks, albums, playlists or mixes.

sources.label: Morphe patches for TIDAL: search songs, albums and artists on Rate Your Music
sources.author: KYT
patch_list: Add Rate Your Music search
Adds an option to the track, album and artist menus to search them on Rate Your Music.
